pattern.description: The regular expression pattern to search for in file contents

-A.description: Number of lines to show after each match (rg -A). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

context.description: Number of lines to show before and after each match (rg -C). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-o.description: Print only the matched (non-empty) parts of each matching line, one match per output line (rg -o / --only-matching). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to false.

type.description: File type to search (rg --type). Common types: js, py, rust, go, java, etc. More efficient than include for standard file types.

offset.description: Skip first N lines/entries before applying head_limit, equivalent to "| tail -n +N | head -N". Works across all output modes. Defaults to 0.

multiline.description: Enable multiline mode where . matches newlines and patterns can span lines (rg -U --multiline-dotall). Default: false.

24	## Technical Notes:
25	- Whitespace: exactly space, tab, `\r`, `\n`. Comments: `--` to end of line (`\n`) or end of input.
26	- Keywords (reserved, case-insensitive): `SELECT DISTINCT FROM WHERE GROUP BY HAVING ORDER ASC DESC LIMIT OFFSET AS JOIN INNER LEFT OUTER ON AND OR NOT IS NULL LIKE ESCAPE IN`. Token kind `KEYWORD`, `value` upper-case, `text` as written. `COUNT SUM AVG MIN MAX` are ordinary IDENTs.
27	- Unquoted identifier `[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*` (ASCII only) that is not a keyword → `IDENT` (value as written). Quoted identifier `"..."` with `""` → `"`; may contain any character including newlines and may equal a keyword → `QIDENT` (value unescaped). Unterminated → LexError `unterminated quoted identifier` at the opening quote.
28	- String literal `'...'` with `''` → `'`; may span lines; backslash literal → `STRING`. Unterminated → `unterminated string literal` at the opening quote.
29	- Numbers: INTEGER `[0-9]+`; REAL `[0-9]+\.[0-9]*([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?`, `\.[0-9]+([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?`, `[0-9]+[eE][+-]?[0-9]+`. Take the longest match of these forms; if the next character is an ASCII letter, digit, `_` or `.`, raise `invalid number literal` at the literal start. Examples: errors `12abc`, `1e`, `1e+`, `1..2`, `1.2.3`, `1_0`, `1.5e`, `1.e`; valid `1.`, `1.e5`, `.5`, `1e10`, `1E+3`. `.` not followed by a digit is OP `.`. Values: `int(text)` / `float(text)`.
30	- Operators (OP): `+ - * / % = <> != < <= > >= ( ) , . ;` (and `*`). Lone `!` → `unexpected character '!'`.
31	- Any other character (incl. `#`, `é` outside quotes, NBSP, form feed, `` ` ``, `[`) → `unexpected character 'X'` at that character.
32	- Positions are code-point offsets; errors built with `LexError.at(sql, offset, msg)`. Final token `EOF` at `start == end == len(sql)`, `text == ''`.
33	- Never use `str.isdigit/isalpha/isalnum/isidentifier/isspace` or `\d`/`\w` (implementation-plan §2 rule 4).

24	## Technical Notes:
25	- Whitespace: exactly space, tab, `\r`, `\n`. Comments: `--` to end of line (`\n`) or end of input.
26	- Keywords (reserved, case-insensitive): `SELECT DISTINCT FROM WHERE GROUP BY HAVING ORDER ASC DESC LIMIT OFFSET AS JOIN INNER LEFT OUTER ON AND OR NOT IS NULL LIKE ESCAPE IN`. Token kind `KEYWORD`, `value` upper-case, `text` as written. `COUNT SUM AVG MIN MAX` are ordinary IDENTs.
27	- Unquoted identifier `[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*` (ASCII only) that is not a keyword → `IDENT` (value as written). Quoted identifier `"..."` with `""` → `"`; may contain any character including newlines and may equal a keyword → `QIDENT` (value unescaped). Unterminated → LexError `unterminated quoted identifier` at the opening quote.
28	- String literal `'...'` with `''` → `'`; may span lines; backslash literal → `STRING`. Unterminated → `unterminated string literal` at the opening quote.
29	- Numbers: INTEGER `[0-9]+`; REAL `[0-9]+\.[0-9]*([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?`, `\.[0-9]+([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?`, `[0-9]+[eE][+-]?[0-9]+`. Take the longest match of these forms; if the next character is an ASCII letter, digit, `_` or `.`, raise `invalid number literal` at the literal start. Examples: errors `12abc`, `1e`, `1e+`, `1..2`, `1.2.3`, `1_0`, `1.5e`, `1.e`; valid `1.`, `1.e5`, `.5`, `1e10`, `1E+3`. `.` not followed by a digit is OP `.`. Values: `int(text)` / `float(text)`.
30	- Operators (OP): `+ - * / % = <> != < <= > >= ( ) , . ;` (and `*`). Lone `!` → `unexpected character '!'`.
31	- Any other character (incl. `#`, `é` outside quotes, NBSP, form feed, `` ` ``, `[`) → `unexpected character 'X'` at that character.
32	- Positions are code-point offsets; errors built with `LexError.at(sql, offset, msg)`. Final token `EOF` at `start == end == len(sql)`, `text == ''`.
33	- Never use `str.isdigit/isalpha/isalnum/isidentifier/isspace` or `\d`/`\w` (implementation-plan §2 rule 4).
34	- Contract: Lexical rules; Error handling (Lex row). AC4.

39	* Keywords recognised case-insensitively (`select`, `SeLeCt`) with upper-case `value`; `count` is IDENT; `"select"` is QIDENT with value `select`.
40	* `'it''s'` → STRING value `it's`; `"a""b"` → QIDENT value `a"b`; multi-line string spans lines and following tokens report correct line/column.
41	* Unterminated string / quoted identifier errors at the opening quote with the exact messages.
42	* Each invalid-number example raises `invalid number literal` at the literal start; each valid example yields the right kind and value.
43	* `--` comments ignored to end of line; `SELECT --x` yields SELECT then EOF; `1 - -1` lexes as INTEGER, OP, OP, INTEGER.

25	## Technical Notes:
26	- Grammar (contract EBNF): `query = SELECT [DISTINCT] item {, item} [FROM tableref {join}] [WHERE expr] [GROUP BY expr {, expr}] [HAVING expr] [ORDER BY order {, order}] [LIMIT INT] [OFFSET INT] [;] EOF`; `item = * | name . * | expr [[AS] name]`; `tableref = name [[AS] name]`; `join = ([INNER] JOIN | LEFT [OUTER] JOIN) tableref ON expr`; `order = expr [ASC|DESC]`; `expr = and {OR and}`; `and = not {AND not}`; `not = NOT not | cmp`; `cmp = add [cmpop add | IS [NOT] NULL | [NOT] LIKE add [ESCAPE STRING] | [NOT] IN ( expr {, expr} )]`; `add = mul {(+|-) mul}`; `mul = unary {(*|/|%) unary}`; `unary = (-|+) unary | primary`; `primary = INT | REAL | STRING | NULL | call | colref | ( expr )`; `call = name ( (* | expr) )`; `colref = name [. name]`; `name = IDENT | QIDENT`.
